look_here_first: Measure several mature leaves and compare intact axillary racemes. Leaves often 10–20 × 5–8 mm; short racemes have crowded flower bases. Do not identify by white flowers or scent alone.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, usually small oblong or oblanceolate blades; typically entire but some forms toothed.

key_traits.label: Racemes
key_traits.text: Short, dense, axillary; flower bases close together.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Branched woody aromatic shrub; axillary leafy fascicles may be present.

lookalikes.differences: A. virgata usually has larger toothed leaves and lax, flexuose racemes; Lantana has rounded heads; Verbena is herbaceous with spikes.
